ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the tailfin of the fish called?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is an anatomy/part labeling diagram of a fish, with the fish head on the right side and the tail on the left side. The largest tail fin on the left side is pointed to by the arrow of label H. Reasoning: The question asks what the fish's "tailfin" is called, not which letter corresponds to it. The fin at the tail of a fish is called the caudal fin in fish anatomy.
